posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I'm assuming you used Special Effect: Escape to implement this? I'm assuming you haven't run into an issue where you get Game Over after escaping (which can happen if escape isn't done properly).
If you want it to
exactly
follow the default Escape command, but always succeed, the script call would be:
JavaScript:
BattleManager._preemptive = true;
BattleManager.processEscape()
The
processEscape
command goes through the regular "chance to escape" routine, but the
_preemptive
flag overrides the chance to 100%. You'd need to put this in a Common Event instead of using Special Effect: Escape. Since it's a common event, that means you can easily check if it's a battle flagged as inescapable, using the following script call in a Conditional Branch:
JavaScript:
BattleManager.canEscape()

Are you using VisuStella for action sequences? I'd just add an action sequence to the item where I move all the alive party members and then use abort battle (that goes to the escape branch too I think). And if you need add +1 to the $gameSystem._escapeCount
Though it seems like abort battle doesn't work in action sequences, but you can make the item turn on a switch and use base troop event with moment switch is ON to do the same. And then just put in the plugin settings to turn the switch OFF when battles end. LOL.
